Prices the body of a Payment without creating it: the lines at the prices Voucherly resolves, the delivery fee and the coupons passed by `couponCode` in `discounts`. Use it to show the customer the total the Payment will have before it is created. A coupon that does not apply answers the same 400 as Create a Payment.
